links.outcome: Segmentation accuracy compared across five competing AI platforms against expert reference on same scans
links.effect: Significant differences among platforms (p < 0.001); Relu Creator and 3D Slicer most accurate (≈0.5 mm, no >2.0 mm deviations); Atomica and BlueSkyPlan more variable with more deviations >2.0 mm.
links.quote: Significant performance differences were observed among platforms (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Performance variation by scanner and canal side
links.effect: Scanner- and side-related effects were statistically significant but clinically negligible.
links.quote: Scanner- and side-related effects were statistically significant but clinically negligible.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of the accuracy of five AI platforms for mandibular canal segmentation on retrospective CBCT images against expert annotations, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
